description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/att-replace-remove: p1's delete used a child recordset invalidated by the earlier parent Update (3420), so that deletion never happened. On a writable r-cplx-rebuild-cx-attach: p1, under parent Edit, the first attachment is replaced (child MoveFirst, Edit, FileData.LoadFromFile of replace.bin, FileName 'renamed.dat', Update; DBEngine.Errors); a second is added by assigning FileData bytes and FileName directly; the parent is updated and the group of p1 read. Then everything is RE-ACQUIRED: a new recordset, parent Edit, a fresh child, MoveFirst, Delete, parent Update, and the group of p1 is read; then p2 with a fresh recordset and child: Edit, MoveFirst, Delete twice, Update, group read. The Database is closed and the group of p1 and p2 read through a read-only reopen.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
